title: uses retrieved payment success time and invoice service boundaries, never webhook arrival
judgment: Actual invoice reconciliation must use retrieved paid_at and invoice service boundaries, emit the complete recorded event with EUR/6999/source identities, and return amountMinor. A webhook-arrival timestamp or provider-period substitution breaks this literal event oracle; the route Purchase keeper does not assert this whole event.

title: zero authorization invoice records no payment or revenue
judgment: Move the no payment-intent read assertion to the existing restored-binding final reconciliation. It already asserts null payment and no ledger record on the identical zero subscription-create invoice after binding restoration.

title: a late failure delivery follows the retrieved successful payment
judgment: Actual failed-webhook keeper already records succeeded and looks up exactly stripe:purchase_completed:in_1. The real route derives this key exclusively from returned first_paid phase, preserving both donor assertions.

title: unpaid first invoice enters payment ledger without paid conversion
judgment: Open unpaid first invoice must produce failed ledger input, null payment and no invoice-payment retrieval. A fabricated success result or unnecessary paid-evidence lookup differs from the late-failure paid case.

title: legacy paid invoices work with trial runtime absent or configured
judgment: Non-trial legacy invoices return null with runtime both absent and configured. Routing all invoices into trial reconciliation would reject a supported legacy payment; retain both configuration inputs.

title: `${name} never grants access or falls through to legacy revenue`
judgment: Full invalid-authority table checks customer/price/capture/amount/period/provider-state/line/ledger failures reject instead of granting access or returning legacy-null. These deliberately different read-set guards are not subsumed by one successful route fixture.

title: short delayed-payment period remains retryable reconciliation, without an invented renewal
judgment: A shorter paid service period returning reconciliation_required must throw rather than fabricate the full renewal. Exact uncertain ledger outcome is absent from successful webhook inputs.

title: invoked success webhook routes the trial payment through the canonical ledger
judgment: Actual success dispatch records through real recordTrialPaymentEvent adapter and suppresses legacy messages. Returning early from the success route would fail recorded length; failed-route keeper does not enter this route arm.

title: invoked failure webhook never applies legacy grace or optional failure messages to a trial
judgment: Actual failure dispatch records failed trial payment and does not apply legacy billing grace or enqueue optional failure messaging. Direct invoice reconciliation does not own route fallthrough.

title: invoked webhook propagates reconciliation so its event claim can be retried
judgment: Actual webhook must propagate reconciliation_required so the claim can be retried. Swallowing the error in route invoice dispatch fails assert.rejects; direct throw cannot cover this.

title: missing initial binding is typed retryable and restored binding succeeds without payment
body:
async () => {
  const f = fixture()
  Object.assign(f.invoice, { billing_reason: "subscription_create", amount_due: 0, amount_paid: 0 })
  f.sub.status = "trialing"
  f.setBillingPresent(false)
  f.enrollment.provider_agreement_id = null
  await assert.rejects(f.run(), (error: unknown) => {
    assert.ok(error instanceof TrialInvoiceBillingLinkPending)
    assert.equal(error.agreementId, "sub_1")
    assert.equal(error.enrollmentId, f.enrollment.id)
    return true
  })
  assert.equal(f.recorded.length, 0)
  f.enrollment.provider_agreement_id = "sub_1"
  await assert.rejects(f.run(), TrialInvoiceBillingLinkPending)
  f.setBillingPresent(true)
  assert.equal((await f.run())?.payment, null)
  assert.equal(f.recorded.length, 0)
}

title: `${name} never becomes a billing-link-pending warning`
judgment: Full pending-warning negative table preserves database errors, foreign/unsafe authority and noninitial invalid states as hard reconciliation failures. Generalizing every missing link to benign pending would violate these differing guard inputs.

title: missing runtime with an absent binding retains reconciliation alert
judgment: Missing runtime plus absent binding remains an alert-worthy reconciliation error. A permissive missing-binding fallback before runtime verification would incorrectly return the typed warning.

title: actual missing-binding handler failure releases for retry, then binding restoration succeeds
judgment: Actual handler failure releases claim and remains retryable, then succeeds after binding restoration. Helper DTO assertions do not cover failure classification/claim settlement order.

title: existing partial billing row does not become pending
judgment: An existing partial billing row must be treated as reconciliation, not pending. Removing row-shape validation misclassifies corrupt established storage as an expected creation race.

title: reserved enrollment can wait for initial binding before a user exists
judgment: Reserved enrollment lacking a user can legitimately await initial binding. Requiring a bound user before classifying this initial zero invoice would turn the supported race into a hard error.

judgment: Transfer typed trial_unavailable, zero billing access, null profile status, exact no-invoice/no-proration cancellation and released-claim assertions onto the existing recovery keeper initial identical denial call.

title: unexpected Stripe admission state requires reconciliation without neutralizing the agreement
judgment: Unexpected admission result invalid_state must reconcile without cancellation or release. Treating every non-active result as prior-use denial would mutate an unproven agreement.

title: provider neutralization timeout remains retryable and does not release the claim or grant access
judgment: Transfer typed reconciliation code/cause, no billing access and no release onto cleanup keeper initial identical deny+failCancel ensure call.

title: missing runtime, foreign enrollment, revoked admission and invalid card proof fail before account writes
judgment: Runtime absence, foreign enrollment, revoked admission and invalid card proof each stop before account writes. Reordering account creation before proof would fail the empty-write oracle; denial after a valid proof is later.

title: unsafe Stripe authorization proof is terminal reconciliation and preserves its proof cause
judgment: Unsafe retrieved authorization is terminal typed reconciliation retaining the proof cause. Mapping it to an account retry or ordinary trial-used denial would violate actionable recovery semantics.

title: competing enrollment ownership cannot be overwritten or grant product access
judgment: A competing owner winning compare-and-set cannot be overwritten or granted access. A blind update in admitStripeTrialAccount bypasses this race-specific oracle.

title: lost cancellation response or claim release failure converges from persisted denial on redelivery
judgment: Persisted denied attempts recover after lost cancel response or claim-release failure without re-admitting or extending access. A one-shot cancellation implementation cannot converge on these two redeliveries.

title: a successful payment discovered while neutralizing remains a reconciliation case
judgment: A successful payment found while neutralizing prevents claim release/access and remains reconciliation. Cancel success alone is insufficient because captured money exists.

title: existing independent paid access cancels the duplicate trial and leaves original access intact
judgment: Independent existing paid access neutralizes duplicate trial while preserving original profile/billing access and returning existing-access recovery. Prior-use empty-access fixture cannot cover preservation of an independent paid entitlement.

title: read-only Stripe return recovery exposes a released prior-use denial only after binding proof
judgment: Primary C2 keeper: one existing denial call followed by read-only recovery proves bound released denial and no extra effects/cancellation/account. Transfer donor details before snapshot; preserve recovery observations.

title: read-only Stripe return recovery sends outstanding cleanup and unsafe replay bindings to reconciliation
judgment: Primary C3 keeper: cleanup failure, apparently unconfirmed cancellation and foreign customer replay all remain reconciliation. Existing separate fixtures are retained unchanged; transferred timeout cause/access/release assertions apply only to first call.

title: persisted Stripe existing-access reason does not outrank outstanding cleanup
judgment: Persisted existing-access reason must not override outstanding provider cleanup. Returning existing access before checking neutralization would hide unresolved collection risk.

title: a deleted or missing bound owner never recreates an account on late trial callbacks
judgment: Deleted/missing bound owner on late callback must not recreate an account. Retrying account creation for an already active historical enrollment would violate deletion and ownership boundaries.

title: accepted trial callbacks use configured runtime even when new enrollment is disabled
judgment: Configured runtime remains usable for accepted callbacks when enrollment is disabled. Applying the new-sale feature gate to recovery would strand existing contracts.

title: trial authorization timestamp qualifies a legacy-quiz lead for the plan destination cutover
judgment: Authorization time controls qualification of legacy-quiz lead for plan cutover, including immutable retry behavior. Current arrival time would migrate old authorization incorrectly.

title: trial marker before activation cannot create an unlinked legacy billing row
judgment: Trial metadata arriving before activation cannot create an unlinked legacy billing row. Removing marker quarantine would make a new legacy row from an unowned subscription.

title: restoration committed after Stripe retrieval fences stale cancellation and all mirrors

title: restore completed before fence capture is resolved by a fresh provider read

title: a newer cancellation declaration invalidates the snapshot even without changing revision
judgment: New cancellation declaration fences a snapshot even without revision increment. Checking revision alone misses cancellationVersion changes.

title: database cancellation CAS rejects a snapshot taken before an actual restore commit
judgment: Actual SQL rejects stale restore snapshots, wrong owner and anon permissions, and increments real revision/cancellation version. JS fake fences do not own transaction/RLS semantics.

title: technical source cancellation appearing during the fresh read never becomes customer cancellation
judgment: Technical source cancellation appearing during fresh provider read must not be interpreted as customer cancellation. Removing technical-operation provenance guard corrupts enrollment cancellation.

title: lost create response is reconciled by stable operation metadata without another subscription
judgment: Lost create response must discover stable operation metadata and avoid a second create. A retry that blindly recreates would increase create count.

title: cancellation racing the successor bind cancels the new subscription and preserves the debt
judgment: Cancellation racing successor bind cancels newly created successor while leaving debt pending. Ordinary already-bound cancellation cannot cover this pre-bind race.

title: `${reason} prevents new collection`
judgment: Existing reason table denies collection for distinct policy/provider guards with zero create calls. These are separate read-set predicates, not interchangeable invalid strings.

title: expired idempotency window never recreates an uncertain absent subscription
judgment: Expired idempotency window must not recreate an uncertain missing successor. Normal retry within the window cannot prove this protection.

title: late customer cancellation compensates an already bound successor without altering the paid period
judgment: Late cancellation after successful bind must compensate existing successor without a second create or changing paid period. Pre-bind race cannot cover bound-state compensation.

title: cancellation after a lost create response discovers and stops the successor
judgment: After lost create response, cancellation must discover and stop hidden successor. Requiring a local known id before cancel would leave it collectible.

title: ambiguous bind response is retried without canceling a possibly committed successor
judgment: Ambiguous bind response remains pending without canceling a potentially committed successor, then reuses it. Treating transport error as definitive bind rejection would wrongly cancel.

title: an external cancellation of the source is never treated as permission for a new agreement
judgment: Externally canceled source is not authority to create a replacement. Treating any canceled state as owned neutralization would create unauthorized collection.

title: provider source neutralization failure prevents successor creation
judgment: Source-neutralization provider failure stops before successor create. Swallowing it would permit competing collectible subscriptions.

title: incorrect successor anchor is canceled rather than left to collect at an unaccepted date
judgment: Wrong successor anchor is canceled and never confirmed. A successful create response alone cannot prove accepted collection date.

title: unrelated customer pages do not hide a successor after a lost response
judgment: Paginated unrelated customer subscriptions must not hide the operation successor after response loss. Reading only page one would recreate or leave debt pending.

title: verifies a server-retrieved seven-day card trial and records later invoice proof obligations
judgment: Transfer complete literal verified DTO to the existing provider-retrieval keeper using the same fixture authorities/offer/time/mode. Actual retrieval invokes this verifier and returns its object unchanged.

title: requires Stripe's exact seven-day provider interval and the current time to remain inside it
judgment: Exact seven-day duration and exclusive end boundary must reject one-second deviations and now==trialEnd. Successful DTO cannot guard either arithmetic or boundary comparison.

title: accepts Stripe's paid status for a completed zero-total checkout with a verified trial
judgment: Retrieved paid zero-total checkout has a distinct accepted payment_status and still carries unpaid future-invoice obligations. Rejecting all paid checkouts would fail this case while default no_payment_required passes.

title: accepts no pending setup intent with a saved card, but requires any present intent to succeed and bind
judgment: Absent pending setup intent is accepted with saved card, but each present authority must succeed and bind exact customer/card/id/mode. Default null setup cannot cover present-object security guards.

title: requires flexible billing and the expected Stripe mode on every retrieved authority object
judgment: Flexible billing and livemode on session/subscription/payment method independently gate authorization. Checking only one retrieved object would accept the differing foreign-mode inputs.

title: requires the accepted once coupon on annual introductory terms and no discount on monthly terms
judgment: Monthly unexpected-discount row lacks required unit_amount/tax_behavior and fails price guard before discount policy. Retain annual duration/id/absence branches; repair monthly price completeness in the existing call before asserting no-discount policy.

title: requires immutable provider terms while allowing an already-attached Price or Coupon to retire
judgment: Immutable price/coupon contract rejects monetary/tax/product/redemption mismatches but accepts retired already-attached provider catalog objects. New-sale active catalog attestation intentionally has different semantics.

  assert.deepEqual(calls.find(({ resource }) => resource === "coupon")?.expand, ["applies_to"])
})
judgment: Primary C1 keeper: actual authority retrieval uses session/subscription/payment method/coupon ids and required expansions. Transfer full verified DTO; keep retrieval order/expansion assertions so missing or unexpanded authority is caught.

title: provider evidence retrieval fails closed for cross-customer and unresolved setup authorities
judgment: Retrieval rejects cross-customer and unresolved setup authorities before proving authorization. Direct verifier receives resolved objects and cannot detect retrieval composition errors.

title: a provider outage remains retryable instead of becoming an authorization denial
judgment: Provider outage propagates as retryable rejection rather than null authorization denial. Converting transport errors to a denied proof violates recovery semantics.

title: freezes accepted trial terms before Stripe and binds the verified session
judgment: The positive freeze_analytics-before-provider assertion accepts -1 < provider index if analytics freezing is removed. Preserve request/management-catalog literals; require both observed indices >=0 before ordering in this existing call. No whole declaration deletion.

title: rollout and eligibility failures cannot fall through to paid checkout
judgment: Rollout/eligibility table must reject before provider creation and cannot fall through to paid checkout. Ignoring any independent eligibility predicate starts an unauthorized provider flow.

title: expired ambiguous attempts and foreign provider bindings do not create or expose another session
judgment: Expired ambiguous or foreign-bound attempt cannot create another session or expose unrelated secret. Ordinary fresh attempt does not cover uncertain replay/binding.

title: a retry may keep an old coupon but cannot silently select a different interval or owner
judgment: Frozen coupon may remain old but interval/owner changes are refused before provider creation. Reinterpreting request scope on retry would transfer or reprice accepted identity.

title: a completed bound session resumes without attempting to reserve an already consumed trial again
judgment: Completed bound session resumes without reserving consumed trial again. Re-running reservation before retrieving a completed attempt strands successful checkout.

title: a failed durable binding cannot expose a client secret
judgment: Failed durable session binding must throw and withhold client secret. Returning provider response before successful storage admits an untracked attempt.

title: confirmed uncompleted session expiry frees the reserved trial without consuming eligibility
judgment: Confirmed uncompleted expiry releases reserved claim without consuming eligibility and rejects unsafe retry. Releasing before confirmed expiry or retaining forever are distinct failures.

title: frozen management offers survive runtime price and coupon changes before a request freeze retry
judgment: Management catalog frozen before request-freeze outage survives current runtime changes. Re-attesting/replacing the frozen catalog during retry changes the accepted switch offer.

title: SQL only leases ledger debt once, preserves full paid period, and fences stale workers
body:
async (t) => {
  const pg = await database(t)
  await pg.exec("SET ROLE service_role")
  const [op] = await claim(pg)
  assert.ok(op)
  assert.equal(op.paid_through_at, "2099-02-10T12:00:00+00:00")
  assert.equal((await claim(pg)).length, 0)
  assert.equal(await checkpoint(pg, op, "begin_create"), false)
  assert.equal(await checkpoint(pg, op, "neutralized"), true)
  assert.equal(await checkpoint(pg, op, "begin_create"), true)
  await pg.exec(
    "UPDATE private.stripe_trial_continuation_operations SET lease_until = clock_timestamp() - interval '1 second'",
  )
  const [newOwner] = await claim(pg)
  assert.notEqual(newOwner.lease_token, op.lease_token)
  assert.equal(await checkpoint(pg, op, "observed", "sub_new"), false)
  assert.equal(await checkpoint(pg, newOwner, "observed", "sub_new"), true)
  assert.equal(await checkpoint(pg, newOwner, "observed", "sub_other"), false)
  assert.equal(
    await checkpoint(pg, newOwner, "resolved"),
    false,
    "cannot resolve before parent CAS binds successor",
  )
}

judgment: Real SQL leases once, retains full paid-through value, enforces neutralized-before-create, token fencing and observed-id consistency. Mock checkpoint state cannot prove SQL concurrency and idempotency.

title: SQL cancellation prevents creation and binding while retaining the received paid period
judgment: Real SQL customer cancellation forbids create/bind while retaining paid period. Dropping cancellation predicate permits new collection after durable declaration.

title: SQL binding is idempotent, preserves the original link, and resolves durable debt
judgment: Real SQL repeated binding preserves original agreement, resolves debt, forbids compensation create and denies unauthorized role. Provider fake does not own these storage/grant constraints.

title: authenticated retry route invokes consumer and leaves failed repair scheduled without changing payment access
judgment: Worker route requires bearer authentication and invokes consumer on authorized request while retaining failed repair scheduling. Direct consumer cannot guard route admission.

title: consumer releases pending operations through the fenced retry checkpoint
judgment: Pending consumer result checkpoints retry using fenced operation token. Returning pending without checkpoint leaves a stuck lease.

title: paid cancellation SQL verifies owner and persists paid-through access before provider work
judgment: Paid-cancellation SQL validates owner, stores paid-through cancellation before provider work and rejects stale confirmation. Provider cancellation test cannot establish this database boundary.

title: paid cancellation confirmation waits for an uncertain hidden successor to be neutralized
judgment: Uncertain hidden successor blocks SQL cancellation confirmation. Confirming only the visible original agreement leaves hidden collection unresolved.

title: restoration SQL freezes setup/subscription requests, rejects a new trial, and fences newer cancellation
judgment: Restoration SQL freezes exact setup/subscription request, rejects added trial, divergent retry and newer cancellation, and restricts permissions. Fake provider request capture cannot establish transactional CAS.

title: recovery SQL freezes exactly one request and excludes automatic repair while recovery is pending
judgment: Recovery SQL freezes one request and excludes automatic repair while pending, including replay and permission guards. Continuation-only leases do not cover this competing recovery workflow.

title: `Stripe ${source} to ${target} switch preserves deadline and first-payment coupon without immediate billing`
judgment: Both existing month/year switch directions preserve deadline/anchor/proration and apply or remove introductory coupon appropriately. They execute distinct discount branches; no grouping/deletion credit.

title: restore clears both Stripe cancellation forms and leaves the original deadline
judgment: Restore clears cancel_at and cancel_at_period_end without item replacement or deadline reset. Plan switch request does not cover pure restoration.

title: fully canceled Stripe source needs fresh hosted approval and cannot silently become collectible
judgment: Fully canceled source requires fresh hosted approval and zero silent updates. Updating it as if merely scheduled would restore unauthorized collection.

title: lost update response is read back and committed without reapplying the discount
judgment: Lost update response is reconciled from provider truth with one mutation. Blind retry can reapply coupon or mutate terms twice.

title: a newer cancellation prevents commit and leaves the original deadline noncollectible
judgment: Newer cancellation abandons commit and restores noncollectible original offer. Ignoring operation fence lets stale management overwrite cancellation.

title: wrong future total rolls back to the existing offer and reports an abandoned change
judgment: Unexpected future invoice total rolls back provider offer and prevents commit. Price-id correctness alone cannot establish actual future collectible total.

title: `${reason} prevents changes to a trial operation`
judgment: Reason table blocks management for distinct customer/mode/deadline authority mismatches before provider updates. Exact update success does not guard these refusal branches.

title: paid cancellation persists before provider work and cancels only the owned successor at paidThrough
judgment: Paid cancellation is durably requested first and targets only owned successor at paidThrough with no proration. Trial cancellation deadline and original agreement inputs cannot cover this paid successor branch.

title: cancellation capability binds a stable request to its enrollment
judgment: Capability cryptographically binds enrollment/request and rejects wrong secret. Provider reconciliation never authenticates this public capability boundary.

title: reconciliation schedules and re-verifies the immutable trial deadline before confirmation
judgment: Owner schedules exact immutable deadline without proration, rereads, then confirms durable operation. Confirming update response without provider observation would violate ordering.

title: reconciliation fails closed for wrong provider ownership, deadline, mode, or ineffective mutation
judgment: Ownership/deadline/mode/ineffective-provider variants stay pending without confirmation. Distinct provider predicates remain independently meaningful.

title: configuration failure and a lost provider response remain pending without confirmation
judgment: Unavailable runtime leaves pending and never confirms; title also mentions lost response but that path is independently exercised below. Keep genuine configuration fail-closed assertion, no phantom second proof claim.

title: a no-op provider update never confirms cancellation
judgment: A provider update that does nothing must not be confirmed. Returning updated object without re-verification falsely confirms this cancellation.

title: a lost update response reconciles the already scheduled cancellation on retry
judgment: Lost update response converges from already-scheduled provider state on retry with one mutation and one exact-bound confirmation. No-op update has different persisted provider state.

title: already canceled free agreement uses ended_at and checks remaining invoices
judgment: Already canceled free agreement uses ended_at plus remaining-invoice evidence, confirming only zero collectible balance. Scheduled cancellation does not prove already-ended reconciliation.

title: dry run verifies historical canceled membership without writing; apply uses actual captured card and verified canonical owner
judgment: Dry run verifies without writes; apply records actual captured-card identity and canonical verified account/email for historical canceled membership. Current-subscription eligibility cannot replace historical payment provenance.

title: processing approval gates even provider reads; free and non-subscription invoices cannot seed history
judgment: Processing approval gates provider reads; zero/non-subscription invoice cases produce no history write. Removing read gate leaks sensitive processing before authorization.

title: identity mismatch, unverified email, failed or disputed capture, future timestamp and partial invoice evidence never write
judgment: Full mismatched identity/email/capture/dispute/future/partial-evidence table must reject with no write. Each differing provider/owner field feeds a real validation predicate.

title: older direct charge invoices and refunds retain genuine prior use; absent card fingerprint writes only owner claims
judgment: Direct-charge legacy invoices and refunds preserve genuine prior use; absent fingerprint records only verified owner claims. Requiring modern payment-intent/card presence discards supported history.

title: manual payment records and truncated invoice payment collections require review
judgment: Manual payment records and truncated invoice payments require review without write. Treating a partial collection as complete can misattribute paid history.

title: explicit existing QA seed classification excludes history but real profile backfills remain eligible for verification
judgment: Explicit QA seed excludes history while ordinary profile backfills remain eligible. Treating all backfill metadata as test data or none as test data changes eligibility.

title: disabled or unverified restricted trial requests never create a legacy paid checkout
judgment: Disabled/restricted unverified route returns404 before either checkout service. Service injection means this is route-policy proof, not provider creation proof.

title: anonymous public trial keeps the lead flow without treating its email as verified
judgment: Anonymous public request retains lead scope and empty verified email/claims. Promoting lead email to trusted identity would bypass verification.

title: trial checkout preserves acquisition context and records zero current revenue
judgment: Route preserves acquisition/internal-test context and checkout_started event value0/reference. Trial provider builder does not own funnel event mapping.

title: trial intent rejects unsupported protocols and propagates trial failures without paid fallback
judgment: Unsupported raw protocols are rejected before service and trial failure returns503 without paid fallback. Successful route input cannot guard request schema and error dispatch.

title: builds the server-pinned annual seven-day trial Checkout request
judgment: Exact annual request pins card collection, metadata, seven-day trial, full-price line item and once coupon with no excluded-payment-method key. Checkout service keeper asserts only a subset of this provider request.

title: builds the monthly 9.99 trial without a coupon
judgment: Monthly request uses999 price and omits discounts while retaining exact subscription metadata/trial settings. Annual branch does not prove coupon absence.

title: rejects quarterly and mismatched offer snapshots
judgment: Unsupported quarter and interval/snapshot mismatches throw. Passing ordinary month/year cannot cover raw protocol mismatch.

title: rejects raw one-time and client-price overrides
judgment: Raw one-time and client price overrides throw even when other trial terms are valid. Static type restrictions do not protect runtime input.

title: leaves the legacy builder's paid subscription request unchanged
judgment: Legacy quarterly paid builder remains free of all trial-only subscription_data/discount/collection fields. Separate monthly spec was read but no approved full-union keeper in this cohort; retain exact legacy protocol.

title: attests a sellable annual trial catalog and returns identities only
judgment: New-sale annual attestation requires actual returned price/coupon identities and exact retrieval/expansion sequence. Attached retired authorization semantics intentionally differ from sellability.

title: requires every new-sale price and coupon fact without leaking mismatch detail
judgment: Every mutable price/coupon sellability/monetary/tax/product limit must reject with generic mismatch detail. Authorization permits already-attached retirement and cannot own this new-sale gate.

title: does not retrieve a coupon for a no-discount monthly offer and propagates provider failures
judgment: Monthly no-discount attestation omits coupon retrieval and propagates provider outage. Annual coupon lookup does not cover absence or retryable failure.
